statement: Bootstrapping a multi-node cluster with partition.defaultReplicaCount=1 either converges or is refused with a typed validation error; join-time formation must not hang forever persisting a replica_operations-p1 self-move against a target of 1.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Repro (3x): set partition.defaultReplicaCount=1 BEFORE bootstrap, then join nodes — join-time formation mints a replica_operations-p1 self-move (workflowStep STOPPING targeting the seed) whose progress persistence loops forever with Query timeout / DISTRIBUTED_PARTICIPANT_FAILURE, stalling the join and the cluster; single-node rc=1 is fine (create-table-partition-provisioning passes). Logs: solve/report/ledger-surplus-drain-stale-actuals-2026-08-22/fanout2.log, fanout-repro6.log, fanout-repro7.log. Fails as a hang, never as a validation error; may resolve as 'unsupported config' with a typed refusal.
